earnings.title: Wabtec Reports Strong Third Quarter 2026 Results
highlights: GAAP Earnings Per Share of $2.42, Up 33.7%; Adjusted Earnings Per Share of $2.83, Up 22.0%
Sales Growth of 8.1% to $3.12 Billion Driven by Both the Freight and Transit Segments
GAAP Operating Margin at 20.0%; Adjusted Operating Margin Up 1.9 pts to 22.9%
Third quarter sales were $3.12 billion and cash from operations was $455 million.

quotes.text: Wabtec delivered another strong quarter, evidenced by sales growth, margin expansion and a 22% increase in adjusted EPS.
quotes.by: Rafael Santana, Wabtec’s Chairman and CEO

outlook: Raised and Tightened 2026 Adjusted Earnings Per Share Guidance; up 22% at the midpoint
Wabtec raised and tightened its 2026 adjusted EPS guidance range to $10.85 - $11.05, raising it $0.20 at the midpoint, or up 22.0% versus prior year.
For the full year 2026, Wabtec continues to expect revenues to be between $12.30 billion to $12.60 billion, up 11.5% at the midpoint versus prior year.
